The Perceptual Quality Auditor flagged 'compression', but the primary artifact is structural/topological (melting joints), not just compression. The Topology Auditor's high mask confidence (0.98) is misleading here; it confirms the chair is one object, but fails to detect the internal topological errors (fused joints) because SAM segments the whole blob. Therefore, the Router's visual observation of fusion is more reliable than the expert's mask confidence.
